title: Monetary Policy Instruments Deep Dive (Direct vs Indirect Tools)
summary: StaticGA — Monetary Policy Instruments Deep Dive (Direct vs Indirect Tools)

items:
**DIRECT INSTRUMENTS (Statutory Reserve Mandates):**
• Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR): Mandatory cash reserves held with RBI under Section 42(1) RBI Act.
• Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR): Mandatory liquid assets held under Section 24 BR Act 1949.

**INDIRECT INSTRUMENTS (Market Liquidity Facilities):**
• Repo & Reverse Repo: Overnight collateralized lending/borrowing benchmark.
• Standing Deposit Facility (SDF): Uncollateralized deposit floor window (6.25%).
• Marginal Standing Facility (MSF): Emergency overnight borrowing ceiling window (6.75%).
• Open Market Operations (OMO): Outright purchase/sale of G-Secs for durable liquidity.
